name: SSN College of Engineering
officialName: Sri Sivasubramaniya Nadar College of Engineering (Autonomous)
summary: SSN College of Engineering was established in 1996 by Dr Shiv Nadar, chairman of HCL Technologies, and named after his father. It is a not-for-profit, unaided college on a 250-acre campus on Rajiv Gandhi Salai (OMR) at Kalavakkam, autonomous and affiliated to Anna University, with about 4,350 students. 65% of seats are filled through TNEA counselling (code 1315) and the remaining 35% management-quota seats are also filled on merit.

applicationPlatform.value: TNEA counselling (college code 1315) for 65% of seats; SSN's own merit-based process for the 35% management quota

scholarships.name: SSN scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Under the college's scholarship policy (in effect since 1999–2000).
scholarships.applicationProcess: See the scholarship policy for criteria and process.

programs.summary: B.E. Biomedical Engineering at SSN, four years; admission through TNEA or the merit-based management quota.

admission.eligibility: Pass in HSC (+2) or equivalent with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, with an average of at least 45% in the three subjects (40% for BC, BCM, MBC/DNC, SC, SCA and ST).
admission.minimumPercent: 45% average in Maths, Physics, Chemistry (40% reserved categories)

process.detail: Online registration ran 3 May – 6 July 2026; fee ₹500 (₹250 SC/SCA/ST).
Merit rank on Mathematics (100) + Physics (50) + Chemistry (50) = 200.
Government-school 7.5% and other special reservations, 13–18 July 2026.
Online choice filling and allotment rounds, 20 July – 30 August 2026.
Confirm the allotted seat and pay fees.
